avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates anticoagulant effects and bleeding risk, compounded by ramucirumab-induced thrombocytopenia
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E to <400 IU/day; monitor for bleeding signs (bruising, hemoptysis, GI bleeding)

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increases bleeding risk through antiplatelet mechanisms; synergistic with ramucirumab-associated thrombocytopenia
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on bleeding precautions

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates platelet dysfunction and bleeding risk in context of ramucirumab immunosuppression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concentrated garlic supplements; monitor platelet counts and bleeding symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet activity may additively increase bleeding risk; generally safe at culinary doses
caution_supplements.action: Use culinary amounts only; avoid high-dose supplements without medical consultation

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (fish oil)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; may slightly increase bleeding tendency in susceptible patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive bleeding; standard doses (1-3g/day) generally acceptable with oversight

avoid_foods.name: Cranberry juice/concentrated products
avoid_foods.mechanism: Contains compounds that may potentiate bleeding risk when combined with ramucirumab-induced thrombocytopenia
avoid_foods.action: Avoid concentrated cranberry products; monitor bleeding indices

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (particularly heavy consumption)
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases bleeding risk and may impair immune function during ramucirumab therapy
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate intake (≤1 drink/day for women, ≤2 for men); counsel on bleeding precautions

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Ramucirumab may increase hypertension risk; excessive sodium may exacerbate blood pressure elevation
caution_foods.action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; maintain low-sodium diet (<2,300mg/day) if hypertension develops

monitoring_notes: Ramucirumab is a monoclonal antibody with minimal hepatic metabolism, making traditional drug-drug interactions rare; however, bleeding risk from thrombocytopenia and hypertension management are primary clinical concerns. Monitor CBC (platelet count), blood pressure, and signs of bleeding or hemorrhage; counsel patients to avoid antiplatelet/anticoagulant supplements and moderate dietary vitamin K consistency.
